changes: Firefox history/bookmark retention uses independent transactional cleanup and preserves original data on incompatible schemas.
Firefox modern localStorage/cache/cookies use shared browser-data layouts; backups restore root files via a restricted @firefox namespace with WAL checks.
Firefox local API navigation and screenshots use the active verified BiDi context.
Cookie import/export retains and validates CHIPS partitionKey.
Imports preserve explicit Direct and empty credentials, clear account and proxy associations, and apply row startup URLs consistently.
New creation drafts discard old credentials and fingerprint identities.
Tag removal uses version-checked profile patches; accepted revisions are published to UI rows.
Extension market uses the backend catalog and installation/assignment state with failure rollback.
Matrix dimensions/gaps reach a validated backend planner; success follows actual bounds application.
Global preferences persist through validated settings IPC and affect browser launch behavior.
Current status cursors avoid full scans; idle UI rows skip redundant publication; API lists support pagination and optional endpoint lookups.
CDP target destruction invalidates stale detach snapshots; a second ordered check distinguishes normal worker shutdown from a lost live session.
Rust stdout uses a bounded nonblocking queue and closes bridge resources on backpressure; saturation and disconnect are unit-tested.
CI includes native Firefox API/data retention checks.
